verdict.rationale: Mailgun documents Route Management for defining inbound rules that forward to an address or store the message, plus inbound parsing that routes mail to your application. Community users confirm rule-based inbound handling and forwarding, though inbound is reportedly unavailable on the free plan. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of recipient/pattern match expressions, explicit evidence of POSTing to multiple different webhook endpoints per rule, and in-depth route API reference docs.
